features.value: Group companies, group chart, governing bodies and documents

texts: Fanalca is a Colombian industrial group based in Cali. It manufactures and assembles motorcycles, auto parts and other industrial products, and has a foundation with educational programmes.
A group with several companies and subsidiaries needs to know at all times who owns what and keep the governing bodies of each company up to date.

uses.title: Every company in the group
uses.text: What is pending in each company and subsidiary, on one screen.

uses.text: Subsidiaries and the chain of control, on any date.

uses.title: The governing bodies
uses.text: Board meetings, officers and minutes for each group company.
